description: Buy one credit pack on the card your human enrolled, within the monthly top-up limit they set — no new human approval. This CHARGES the human’s card. Pass `forCallCredits`: the credits the call you are about to make will spend. A pack is charged only when your spendable credits are below that — the recorded consent charges a pack “each time your credits are not enough for a call you make”, so state what that call needs (from a quote or your plan’s per-call cost); when your credits already cover it, nothing is charged (`not_needed`). Pass a `requestId` you choose as an idempotency handle: a NEW value for each top-up you intend, the SAME value only to re-send a call that may not have completed (a retry returns the pack already charged, never a second one). Read `status`: `bought` added credits (`creditsAdded`) — unless `replayed` is true, which means this requestId had already bought one and nothing new was charged (use a new id next time); `pending` means YOUR pack was charged and is awaiting confirmation (read the balance shortly); `busy` means another top-up is already being charged — nothing was charged for THIS request, so check your balance shortly and re-send the SAME requestId only if you still need one; `limit_reached` means this UTC month’s top-up limit is used up (no charge — do not retry until next month); `not_needed` means your credits already cover the call (no charge); `needs_attention` means the card was declined or needs 3-D Secure, a card payment to Nevermined is disputed, a human must finish setting top-ups up, a prior top-up is stuck, or a prior top-up’s outcome is unconfirmed (it may have been charged) — hand the human `operatorUrl`, never try to confirm it yourself, and do not start a new top-up until they act; `disabled` means a human must turn top-ups on first (give them `operatorUrl`); `unavailable` means nothing was charged — retry with a NEW requestId (reusing this one keeps returning the same settled result). `monthlyLimitUsd`/`boughtThisMonthUsd`/`packPriceUsd` are the human-set limit and this month’s spend. Requires your Nevermined API key on the Authorization header; a commerce OAuth grant must have enabled credit top-ups at consent.
